query:
DELETE FROM bookmark_restore_points
               WHERE (user_id, id) = (
                   SELECT user_id, id FROM bookmark_restore_points
                   WHERE user_id = $1 AND NOT pinned AND id <> $2
                   ORDER BY (kind = 'manual') ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
                   LIMIT 1
               )
               RETURNING size_bytes
